lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots distributed across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, forming a repetitive 2D grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the circular blobs, creating a lattice of grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a pronounced vertical intensity gradient with light-saturated upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Clear presence of multiple commensal remora fish attached to or swimming in close proximity to the ventral region and the right pectoral fin.
